cv.title: Senior Analytics | Commercial Insights & Technical Delivery
summary: Senior analytics professional with experience across growth analytics, business intelligence, and analytics engineering. Strong background in SQL, Python, forecasting, and attribution, with measurable contributions to marketing efficiency and planning accuracy. Experienced in translating business questions into validated models, reliable reporting, and practical recommendations for leadership and customer-facing teams.

bullets: Deliver attribution insights used by all customer success managers to recommend improvements to client channel setups, supported by end-to-end Snowflake pipelines and GoodData reporting.
Own ETL from ingestion to BI consumption; develop reusable SQL models across landing, intermediate, and reporting layers, with Airflow orchestration and GitLab workflows.
Contribute to a quality framework covering approximately 80 tables; own funnel and sales-channel SQL checks for source reconciliation, business-logic accuracy, and join consistency.
Developing Snowflake MCP integration, semantic context, and a Claude-powered dashboarding prototype for business-aware self-service analysis.

projects.name: Traffic Source & Customer Journey Attribution
bullets: Benchmarked 72 customer brands using leave-one-out peer baselines and decomposed performance gaps into mix, efficiency, and interaction effects to guide channel recommendations.
Led delivery of incremental event- and journey-grain enrichment pipelines and a priority-ordered classification taxonomy; corrected upstream paid-versus-organic attribution defects.
Updated the GoodData logical data model and KPI dashboards; validated against production and managed backfills without breaking existing reporting.
Sole Marketing analyst across 51 cities, partnering with leadership on budget scenarios, launch decisions, and expected ROAS, CAC, and subscriber growth.
Owned Snowflake/dbt models and Power BI reporting supporting EUR 200k-500k in monthly marketing spend.

projects.name: Marketing Demand Forecasting & Scenario Dashboard
bullets: Built city-level demand forecasts linking spend to subscriber growth, improving quarterly planning accuracy by approximately 20% versus heuristic estimates.
Translated demand saturation and payback analysis into city-level budget recommendations, contributing to an 8-10% ROAS uplift and supporting 3-5% monthly CAC reductions since Q2 2025.
Designed Markov-chain attribution across paid, CRM, and offline sources, informing a 30% budget shift from Facebook to Google Ads and an 8% reduction in blended CAC within one quarter.
Co-built the analytics platform with BigQuery and dbt, integrating behavioral, marketing, and investment data for reporting across 50k-70k monthly users.
Applied K-means investor segmentation, supporting retention strategies that increased repeat investment by 7% and reduced monthly churn by approximately 4%.
Automated reporting workflows to save approximately 10 hours per week; developed Python automation for voucher, cashback, and SEPA-compatible payments.

projects.name: Conversational BigQuery Analytics Interface
bullets: Built a conversational tool using OpenAI's GPT API to generate and execute BigQuery SQL, enabling non-technical stakeholders to access investor, marketing, and revenue insights.
Developed session-level multi-touch attribution using U-shaped logic and Matillion ETL, informing six-figure quarterly budget reallocations and contributing to 6-8% more qualified leads.
Maintained executive Looker dashboards across paid, organic, and brand channels, providing performance insights to Marketing, Product, and Sales.
Supported A/B testing and funnel analysis on product and search features to inform conversion improvements.

paragraphs: I am applying for the Analytical Lead, Shopping Partners position in Dublin. Supporting strategic retail partnerships through better reporting, scenario analysis, and account prioritization appeals to me because my strongest work has connected technical analysis with commercial decisions. My experience spans marketing analytics, business intelligence, and analytics engineering, with advanced SQL and Python skills and a record of helping leadership and customer-facing teams act on performance insights.

At Aklamio, I led a traffic-source and customer-journey attribution initiative from incremental Snowflake pipelines to GoodData dashboards and recommendations. I benchmarked 72 customer brands using leave-one-out peer comparisons and decomposed performance gaps into mix, efficiency, and interaction effects. All customer success managers use the findings to recommend improvements to client channel setups. I also own ETL workflows and funnel and sales-channel quality checks, validating the business logic behind the metrics used for these decisions.

At NeoTaste, I partnered with marketing leadership across 51 cities, supporting EUR 200,000-500,000 in monthly spend. Snowflake and dbt forecasting models improved quarterly planning accuracy by approximately 20%; scenario dashboards informed allocations that contributed to an 8-10% ROAS uplift. At ecoligo, my Markov-chain attribution model informed a 30% budget shift from Facebook to Google Ads and an 8% reduction in blended acquisition cost. At heycar, attribution analysis supported budget reallocations that increased qualified leads by 6-8%. These experiences required explaining assumptions, performance trends, and trade-offs clearly to business stakeholders.

I would bring this experience to Shopping Partners EMEA: translating evolving reporting needs into dependable analytical tools and practical recommendations for leadership and account teams. My background includes Google Sheets automation, BI reporting, and Google Ads certification. I hold a valid German EU Blue Card and would require employer support for an Irish employment permit. I would welcome the opportunity to discuss my contribution.
